title: TCG:PRO-013

description.text:
All heroes gain "Free Action: Pick up a Fomula in my zone."

A hero with a Formula gains:
*"Unblockable. I can move up to 3 zones."
*"When I move 2 or more zones, exhaust target hero."
*"At the end of the round, I score twice."
